audit.whatIsWrong: The disk chart gave Quinn levels 1, 2, 3, 6 and two items with 'Skill' at 4-5 and first item, while the prose says 'step up the instant you hit 2', 'one combo deletes her', 'out-trade her poke all through levels 4-5', 'pins her for the full combo', 'is your peak'.
audit.why: The packet chart (Quinn/Kled/Kled/Kled/Kled/Kled/Skill) matches the prose and the 56.08% win rate. Quinn owns level 1 only; Kled owns 2 through first item; two items is where she starts to reclaim it.
audit.corrected: Rows 1 through 6 proposed as one group in both layers; row 0 stays Quinn.

audit.why: All four spikes are populated and correctly ordered — level 1 hers, level 2-3 the W-plus-re-E window, level 6 Chaaaaaaaaarge!!!, two items her poke-and-roam scaling.

audit.whatIsWrong: The blind is attached to Vault in six places — 'Vault (Dash/Blind)', 'E vault-blind', 'her knockback-blind', 'blind your W shots the instant you E in', 'she'll vault away and blind your shots', 'Fight into her blind' pointed at E.
audit.why: Vault (E) dashes to the target, damages, slows, briefly interrupts and leaps her back to attack range — no blind and no knockback of you. The blind is Blinding Assault (Q): 1025 range, 11s at rank 1, marks the target and hinders its vision. Against a champion whose damage is four auto-attacks, knowing which button blinds him is the whole matchup.

edits.before: Level 1 is hers and you just eat it — you have no spammable poke, so don't trade autos into her Harrier nimble move speed and let her chip Skaarl for free; last-hit and keep your mount health high. The lane flips at 2: W's on-hit shots online, then at 3 your full Q trap, E dash and W give you the re-E all-in. Bait her E Vault — if she burns the knockback-blind on a poke, E in, Q the trap for the percent-HP slow, W the shotgun procs, and re-E to stick. If she still has E up, she'll vault away and blind your shots, so don't commit blind.
edits.after: Level 1 is hers and you just eat it — you have no spammable poke, so don't trade autos into her Harrier bonus damage and let her chip Skaarl for free; last-hit and keep your mount health high. The lane flips at 2: W's on-hit shots online, then at 3 your full Q trap, E dash and W give you the re-E all-in. Bait Vault, her 12s dash — the moment she spends it, E in, Q the trap for the percent-HP slow, W the shotgun procs, and re-E to stick. Blinding Assault is a separate button: eat that blind on the wave, never mid-combo.
